main_text.p: fidei, nec pro infideli simpliciter habendum) appel-lati sunt ipse & sectæ ejus, Motazali. Nomen autem habent Alwaidii à وعيد Waid, quod minas à Deo peccatoribus denuntiatas significat.

Pro fidei desertore habent] seu, infidelem pronun-ciant eum, qui peccatum aliquod grave commiserit.lin.7. His adhuc severior Iaafar Ebn Mobassbar quidam ex Al Nodamianis, زعم ان سارق الحبة الواحدة affirmavit, qui vel unum granum furatus fuerit, impium esse & à fide prorsus defecisse. Sed plura in hanc sententiam (ان شا الله) infra ubi de Al Chawarejiis agendum.

Ipsumque in Gehenna perpetuò mansurum, &c.] E contra Mokatel quidam è Morjiorum secta quæ Altbaubanis audit, asserebat ان المعصية الثوبانية لا يضر صاحب التوحيد والايمان واذ لا يدخل النار مؤمن Non obesse transgressionem ei qui unitatem Dei agnoscat, & fide praditus sit, neque fidelem ignem ingressurum. Item اذ ه تعالى يخرج ما دون الكفر لا محالة وان المؤمن العاصي يربة بعذب يوم القيامة علي الصراط علي متن جهنم يصيبه لفح النار و لهبها فيتالم بذلك علي مقدار المعصية ثم يدخل الجنة &c. Deum certò condonaturum quic-quid citra infidelitatem fuerit, & Fidelem qui in Dominum suum rebellis fuerit punitum iri die resurrectionis, super vis extensa, supra medium Gehenna, ubi calore & flammalin.8.

page.notes: Arabic passages copied from a small scan and uncertain; the Arabic words are approximate and should be checked against the page. Long s in "Mobassbar" and the proper names is doubtful. The Latin "fidelem ignem ingressurum" may read "fidelem ingressurum" with "ignem" as a printing or reading error; left as read. The Arabic lines in the second paragraph are mostly unverified.
